__comment: Pemmican drying-rack compat. Pemmican loads recipes/drying/ from every mod (server-side) into its synced drying registry, so this is picked up when Pemmican is installed and ignored otherwise (nothing else reads it). Mirrors Pemmican's own EF fruit recipe: air-dry a fresh Wildcraft fruit on the rack into our dried fruit, the same item the clay oven produces.
